plan.json: {"ask":"Track deals, mail and calendar together, brief me 30 minutes before external meetings, draft follow-ups from transcripts, explain deal risks, and ask before changing a deal stage or next step.","data":[{"id":"company","line":"Accounts you sell to, shared organization shape"},{"id":"contact","line":"People at those accounts, shared person shape"},{"id":"deal","line":"Deals with stage, value, next step and risk","create":true},{"id":"note","line":"Follow-up drafts, meeting briefs and risk notes saved on a deal"}],"actions":[{"id":"draft-follow-up","line":"Draft a follow-up note on a deal"},{"id":"explain-risk","line":"Explain the risks on a deal"},{"id":"update-stage","line":"Propose a stage or next-step change and ask before saving"}],"automation":[{"id":"desk-brief","line":"Assemble the daily account desk brief from deals, mail and calendar"},{"id":"meeting-brief","line":"Brief me 30 minutes before each external meeting"},{"id":"draft-follow-up","line":"Draft a follow-up from the transcript and save it as a note on the deal"},{"id":"explain-risk","line":"Explain the risks on a deal"},{"id":"update-stage","line":"Propose a stage or next-step change and ask before saving"}],"screens":[{"id":"desk","line":"Today's account desk: ranked attention list, day agenda and recent changes"},{"id":"deals","line":"Deals by stage"},{"id":"meetings","line":"External meetings on the agenda"},{"id":"deal","line":"One deal with its contact, next step and notes"}],"agent":{"line":"The Account desk assistant runs the desk brief, drafts follow-ups, explains risks and proposes stage changes.","actions":["desk-brief","draft-follow-up","explain-risk","update-stage"]}}
runs/desk-brief.yaml:
run: desk-brief
title: Daily account desk brief
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
steps:
  - id: mail
    title: Search recent mail
    tool: gmail.search
    args:
      q: newer_than:2d -category:promotions
  - id: agenda
    title: Today's calendar
    tool: calendar.list
    args: {}
  - id: brief
    title: Assemble the account desk brief
    agent: account-desk
    prompt: >
      Assemble today's account desk brief. Rank the deals that need attention,
      summarise the day's external meetings from $steps.agenda.output, and cover
      the recent mail in $steps.mail.output. Keep it short and concrete.
runs/draft-follow-up.yaml:
run: draft-follow-up
title: Draft a follow-up from the transcript
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
params:
  deal:
    type: ref
    to: deal
steps:
  - id: transcript
    title: Find the meeting transcript
    tool: gmail.search
    args:
      q: $params.deal.name transcript
  - id: draft
    title: Draft the follow-up
    ai:
      prompt: >
        Write a ready-to-send follow-up email for the deal {{params.deal.name}}.
        Greet {{params.deal.contact.name}} and refer to the points we agreed in
        the transcript below. Do not send it.
        Transcript: $steps.transcript.output
      output:
        type: object
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
        required: [text]
      example:
        text: Hi, thanks for the time today.
  - id: save
    title: Save the follow-up draft
    gate:
      approval: proof
    records.create:
      type: note
      set:
        title: Follow-up draft
        deal: $params.deal.id
        kind: Follow-up
        body: $steps.draft.output.text
        source: Account desk
runs/explain-risk.yaml:
run: explain-risk
title: Explain the risks on a deal
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
params:
  deal:
    type: ref
    to: deal
steps:
  - id: explain
    title: Explain the risks
    ai:
      prompt: >
        Explain the delivery, commercial and relationship risks on the deal
        {{params.deal.name}}, at stage {{params.deal.stage}} worth {{params.deal.value}},
        next step \"{{params.deal.next_step}}\". Call out what is blocking the
        close and what to watch.
      output:
        type: object
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
        required: [text]
      example:
        text: The main risk is a stalled security review.
  - id: save
    title: Save the risk note
    records.create:
      type: note
      set:
        title: Risk review
        deal: $params.deal.id
        kind: Risk note
        body: $steps.explain.output.text
        source: Account desk
runs/meeting-brief.yaml:
run: meeting-brief
title: Brief before external meetings
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
steps:
  - id: agenda
    title: Look at the calendar
    tool: calendar.list
    args: {}
  - id: brief
    title: Brief the upcoming external meeting
    agent: account-desk
    prompt: >
      From $steps.agenda.output, find external meetings starting in the next 30
      minutes. For each one, brief me on the account, the related deal and its
      next step, and the most recent mail thread. If none are coming up, reply
      with nothing.
runs/update-stage.yaml:
run: update-stage
title: Propose a stage or next-step change
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
params:
  deal:
    type: ref
    to: deal
steps:
  - id: propose
    title: Propose the change
    ai:
      prompt: >
        For the deal {{params.deal.name}}, currently at stage {{params.deal.stage}}
        with next step \"{{params.deal.next_step}}\", propose a new stage and a
        new next step, with a one-line reason. Stages are Lead, Qualified,
        Proposal, Won or Lost.
      output:
        type: object
        properties:
          stage:
            type: string
          next_step:
            type: string
          reason:
            type: string
        required: [stage, next_step]
      example:
        stage: Proposal
        next_step: Send pricing
        reason: Discovery is done.
  - id: save
    title: Save the proposed change after approval
    gate:
      approval: proof
    records.update:
      type: deal
      id: $params.deal.id
      set:
        stage: $steps.propose.output.stage
        next_step: $steps.propose.output.next_step
